对局中显示每名干员在自己的作战中造成的伤害（作战中实时，整备时为上一场作战），召: Shows the damage each operator dealt in your own battle during a match (live during a battle, the last battle during prep). Summons count for their summoner; Unite battles are not included. Auto: detailed on a computer, compact on a phone.
关闭后对局中不再弹出任何通知：获得干员、盟约资金等提示，干员退回整备区、淘汰等警: When off, nothing pops up during a match: no notices such as operators obtained or Alliance funds, no warnings such as operators sent back to the bench or elimination, and no reasons why an action cannot be done.

当前作战中的实时数值（绿色为增益，红色为减益）: Live values in the current battle (green: buffed, red: debuffed)

放弃模拟将立即结束本局并返回大厅，本局进度不会保留，也不会进行结算。: Abandoning the simulation ends this match immediately and returns you to the lobby. Progress will not be kept and no results will be tallied.
AI 正在代为操作你的席位: AI is playing your seat for you
该盟约中无法出现的干员数: Operators of this Alliance that cannot appear
本局没有禁用干员: No Operators are banned this match
精锐干员将出现在作战区原位置: The Elite Operator will take the original spot on the Battlefield
精锐干员将进入整备区: The Elite Operator will go to the Bench
再次点击确认升级（{price} 资金）: Tap again to confirm upgrade ({price} Funds)
稍后选择（回合结束后消失）: Pick later (expires at the end of the round)
存在进行中的模拟，是否继续？: A simulation is in progress. Continue it?
已准备就绪后进入的单位保留到下个休整期，届时仍在此处的将被销毁（取消准备则在本休: Units that arrived after Ready are kept until the next Rest Phase; anything still here then will be destroyed (cancel Ready and they are destroyed at the end of this Rest Phase)
放入整备区或战场、配发或使用后才能准备；休整期结束时仍在此处的将被销毁: Move to the Bench or Battlefield, equip or use them before you can Ready; anything still here at the end of the Rest Phase will be destroyed
你的目标生命值耗尽，已被淘汰: Your LP ran out. You have been eliminated
{name}博士的目标生命值已耗尽: Dr. {name} has run out of LP

整备区已满，晋升的精锐干员无法放入: Bench is full. The promoted Elite Operator cannot be placed

你已经是该同盟的博士：先离开同盟，才能以观战身份进入: You are already a Doctor in this Alliance: leave it first to enter as a spectator

将该博士移出同盟: Remove this Doctor from the Alliance
确定将「{name}」移出同盟吗？对方可以凭同盟密钥重新加入。: Remove "{name}" from the Alliance? They can rejoin with the Alliance Key.
观战中 · 不占博士席位，模拟开始后可切换观看各位博士: Spectating · no Doctor seat taken; once the simulation starts you can switch between the Doctors' views
当前语言的界面文字为机器翻译，可能不够准确，欢迎在 GitHub 上指正。: The interface text in this language is machine-translated and may be inaccurate. Corrections are welcome on GitHub.
请按下「{action}」的新按键（Esc 取消）: Press the new key for {action} (Esc to cancel)
「{action}」已改为 {key}；「{other}」原来用 {key}，已: {action} is now {key}; {other} had {key} and now uses {old}
{key} 不能设为快捷键：Esc、Tab、Enter、方向键和功能键留给界面使: {key} cannot be a hotkey: Esc, Tab, Enter, the arrow keys and the function keys belong to the interface
快捷键只能是单个按键，不能搭配 Ctrl、Alt 或 ⌘: A hotkey is a single key, without Ctrl, Alt or ⌘
快捷键需要实体键盘；触屏设备连接键盘后可用: Hotkeys need a physical keyboard; connect one to use them on a touch device
遇到问题时，复制诊断信息并粘贴到 GitHub issue 中，开发者就能看到出: If something goes wrong, copy the diagnostics and paste them into a GitHub issue so the developers can see what happened. They are generated on this device and never uploaded; player names and the room code are replaced.
开发者可以用附上的战斗数据重现这场战斗。: Developers can replay this battle from the attached data.
已复制诊断信息，可以粘贴到 GitHub issue 中: Diagnostics copied. Paste them into a GitHub issue.
浏览器的硬件加速似乎已关闭（或显卡被浏览器停用），画面可能无法显示或很卡。请在浏: Hardware acceleration seems to be off in this browser (or the browser has disabled the graphics card), so the game may not draw or may run slowly. Turn on "Use graphics acceleration" in the browser settings, then restart the browser.
此浏览器无法使用 WebGL，战场只能以简化画面显示。请在浏览器设置中开启硬件加: This browser cannot use WebGL, so the battlefield is shown in a simplified view. Turn on hardware (graphics) acceleration in the browser settings, or use an up-to-date Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
无法写入剪贴板，请手动复制下面的内容: Couldn't write to the clipboard. Copy the text below by hand.
发送太频繁，请稍后再试: Too many reports. Please try again later.
只能在对局结束后一小时内发送: Feedback can only be sent within an hour after a match ends.
未连接到服务器，请稍后再试: Not connected to the server. Please try again later.
发送失败，可以复制内容后通过其他方式反馈: Couldn't send it. You can copy the text and report it another way.
发生了什么？本来应该怎样？在第几回合、哪个干员或敌人身上？: What happened, and what should have happened? Which round, which operator or enemy?
想要什么功能或改进？: What feature or improvement would you like?
